title: Phases Four - Six
subtitle: Test your grasp of Phases Four - Six — narrative maintenance, trigger events, and the lockdown window that prepare sleepers for the mass reveal.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Phases Four through Six of The Great Purge are the theatrical psychological bridge after covert neutralization — Narrative Maintenance holds sleepers docile, Trigger Events push them to the edge of questioning, and the Lockdown Window locks the field for E.B.S. truth. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Phases Four - Six deep-dive, infographic, and video transmissions. Controlled demolition of false reality prepares the path from oblivious slumber through acute questioning into the final broadcast of absolute truth.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Phases Four - Six deep-dive

questions.question: What role do Phases Four through Six play in the Great Purge sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: They form the crucial operational bridge between covert dismantling of parasitic power (Phases One through Three) and overt revelation of the truth (Phases Seven and Eight).
options.rationale: Phases Four through Six bridge the hidden neutralization work of Phases One through Three and the public truth phases that follow in Seven and Eight.

options.label: B
options.text: They replace Phases One through Three entirely by reopening underground economies and restoring full elite power before any public work begins, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: These phases follow after elites and underground economies are already neutralized; they do not reopen that power structure.

options.label: C
options.text: They permanently freeze the timeline at business-as-usual optics so E.B.S. disclosure and mass reveal never arrive for sleepers, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Narrative maintenance and lockdown prepare the population for the final truth broadcast rather than cancelling disclosure forever.

options.label: D
options.text: They skip straight to Phase Eight tribunals and executions with no psychological management or lockdown preparation for the population, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Phases Four through Six manage psychology and lockdown first; tribunals belong to Phase Eight after the E.B.S. reveal.

questions.hint: They sit between covert dismantling and overt revelation.

questions.question: After hidden neutralization of elites and underground economies, what do Phases Four, Five, and Six focus on?

options.label: A
options.text: Psychological management and the controlled demolition of the false reality for the still-unawakened population.
options.rationale: These three phases focus entirely on psychological management and controlled demolition of the false reality after covert neutralization.

options.label: B
options.text: Only restoring Vatican hierarchy and banking heads to original free-will command with no psychological bridge for sleepers.
options.rationale: True power centers were already neutralized; these phases are theatrical psychological management, not restoration of parasite command.

options.label: C
options.text: Rebuilding child trafficking pipelines and underground tunnels so the hidden economy can fund a new leadership pyramid.
options.rationale: Underground tunnels, trafficking, and the hidden economy were dismantled in earlier phases; Four through Six manage the public psyche next.

options.label: D
options.text: Immediate open execution of every stand-in on live television before any trigger events or lockdown window is staged.
options.rationale: Stand-ins uphold optics during Narrative Maintenance; open justice and tribunals come later after E.B.S., not at this bridge stage.

questions.hint: Mind management and controlled collapse of the false frame.

questions.question: How does the Four—Six progression move the population psychologically?

options.label: A
options.text: From oblivious slumber to acute questioning, culminating in a locked-down environment prepared for the final broadcast of absolute truth.
options.rationale: The sequence carefully transitions people from oblivious slumber to acute questioning, then into lockdown ready for the truth broadcast.

options.label: B
options.text: From Real Craft Arrival on day one into immediate crystalline reconstruction with no staged psychological bridge phases, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Real Craft Arrival breaks the frequency net after staged fear theatre; Four through Six are the prior psychological bridge.

options.label: C
options.text: From open tribunals and executions straight into permanent war theatre with no mass-reveal containment window for sleepers.
options.rationale: Tribunals are Phase Eight aftermath; Four through Six build toward the truth broadcast through questioning and lockdown first.

options.label: D
options.text: From full E.B.S. realization backward into deeper oblivious slumber with no questioning stage or lockdown preparation at all.
options.rationale: The direction is out of slumber into questioning and lockdown for reveal, not a reverse slide back into deeper sleep.

questions.hint: From deep sleep through questioning into a contained reveal environment.

questions.question: What is The Great Purge in this operational timeline?

options.label: A
options.text: A single-day weather event that dissolves every city overnight with no phased sequence, stand-ins, or psychological management stages.
options.rationale: The purge is a multi-phase operational timeline with covert and theatrical stages, not an instant city-dissolving weather event.

options.label: B
options.text: The multi-phase operational timeline initiated to remove all parasitic control from the realm without triggering premature societal collapse.
options.rationale: The Great Purge is the multi-phase timeline that removes parasitic control while avoiding premature societal collapse.

options.label: C
options.text: A pure finance rebrand that leaves world leaders, trafficking rings, and underground economies fully intact under new logos only.
options.rationale: The purge removes parasitic control structures; earlier phases already neutralized elites and underground economies.

options.label: D
options.text: A bottom-up street revolt that begins with local vendors and never involves Whitehats, E.B.S., or multi-phase military orchestration.
options.rationale: Whitehats and multi-dimensional command orchestrate the takedown; it is not a random bottom-up vendor revolt.

questions.hint: Multi-phase removal of parasitic control without early collapse.

questions.question: Who are Sleepers in this architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: The unawakened masses existing within the 3D illusion who must be psychologically managed before the mass reveal.
options.rationale: Sleepers are the unawakened masses still inside the 3D illusion, held manageable until the mass reveal window opens.

options.label: B
options.text: Neutralized royals and banking heads permanently restored to original free-will power after Phase Three tunnel work ends.
options.rationale: Neutralized leaders are replaced by controlled stand-ins for optics; Sleepers are the unawakened population, not restored elites.

options.label: C
options.text: Allied military and multi-dimensional command forces orchestrating the takedown of the parasitic structure worldwide.
options.rationale: Those allied forces are the Whitehats; Sleepers are the unawakened public who still need psychological management.

options.label: D
options.text: Resonating Sols whose high-frequency signals already cut cleanly through every false-flag narrative without any management.
options.rationale: Resonating Sols anchor truth as frequency fractures; Sleepers are the unawakened who must be managed before mass reveal.

questions.hint: Unawakened masses still inside the 3D illusion.

questions.question: What are Controlled Stand-ins used for after leaders are neutralized?

options.label: A
options.text: Permanent free-will world leaders who keep full original power and never follow scripted meetings, speeches, or public ceremonies, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Stand-ins preserve optics after real power is removed; they are not permanent free-will rulers with original command.

options.label: B
options.text: Truth tribunal judges who immediately execute every parasite on day one without any business-as-usual holding pattern, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Tribunals and executions are Phase Eight aftermath; stand-ins hold the business-as-usual illusion during Narrative Maintenance.

options.label: C
options.text: Clones, biological copies, masked actors, holographic projections, and A.I. driven composites that replace neutralized leaders to maintain optics.
options.rationale: Controlled stand-ins include clones, biological copies, masked actors, holographics, and A.I. composites used to keep leadership optics intact.

options.label: D
options.text: Only underground tunnel workers who dismantle trafficking pipelines by hand with no role in surface leadership appearances, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Tunnel and trafficking dismantling belongs to earlier phases; stand-ins replace leaders for public optics on the surface.

questions.hint: Optics tools that keep neutralized figures looking active.

questions.question: What are Trigger Events designed to do to the public?

options.label: A
options.text: Skip all psychological tension and jump straight to permanent crystalline reconstruction without any public pressure stage.
options.rationale: Phase Five deliberately stages tension and disruptions as a bridge before lockdown and E.B.S., not a skip to reconstruction.

options.label: B
options.text: Stage geopolitical tensions and logistical disruptions designed to push the public toward questioning their reality.
options.rationale: Trigger Events are staged geopolitical tensions and logistical disruptions that push people toward questioning reality.

options.label: C
options.text: Reopen child trafficking pipelines and underground economies so stock markets can rebuild on the old illicit lifeblood.
options.rationale: Those underground systems were dismantled earlier; Trigger Events stage surface geopolitical and supply stress, not a trafficking rebuild.

options.label: D
options.text: Restore full trust in mainstream media and world police so sleepers never question leadership optics again.
options.rationale: Trigger Events push toward questioning; Phase Six later removes traditional media structures and stages internet restrictions.

questions.hint: Staged pressure that pushes people to question reality.

questions.question: What is The Lockdown Window?

options.label: A
options.text: Only Phase One silent arrests of royalty with no street military presence or later E.B.S. containment role at all.
options.rationale: Phase One was covert apex neutralization; the Lockdown Window is Phase Six physical and informational control before E.B.S.

options.label: B
options.text: A permanent cancellation of the Emergency Broadcast System so absolute truth is never delivered to the public.
options.rationale: The Lockdown Window prepares the exact controlled environment necessary for the E.B.S. to take over and broadcast truth.

options.label: C
options.text: An open festival of unrestricted internet and traditional media celebrating business-as-usual leadership forever.
options.rationale: The window restricts communications and stages removal of traditional media structures rather than expanding unrestricted media freedom.

options.label: D
options.text: A period of military presence and communication restriction establishing a controlled environment for the truth broadcast.
options.rationale: The Lockdown Window uses military presence and communication restriction to create the controlled environment for the truth broadcast.

questions.hint: Military presence plus restricted communications before truth lands.

questions.question: Who are the Whitehats in this operation?

options.label: A
options.text: Unawakened sleepers who only watch television and never touch any operational timeline, lockdown, or media transition work, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Sleepers are psychologically managed; Whitehats run the military and multi-dimensional command operation.

options.label: B
options.text: Only NPC programs that glitch endlessly with no role in military presence, narrative management, or truth broadcast preparation, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: NPC programming breaks down under pressure; Whitehats are the allied command forces guiding the purge and narrative transition.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasitic banking heads and Vatican hierarchy restored to full pyramid power after underground economies are rebuilt, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Banking heads and Vatican hierarchy were Phase One targets neutralized at the apex; Whitehats orchestrate their removal, not their return.

options.label: D
options.text: Allied military and multi-dimensional command forces orchestrating the takedown of the parasitic structure and managing the narrative transition.
options.rationale: Whitehats are allied military and multi-dimensional command forces that orchestrate the takedown and manage the narrative transition.

questions.hint: Allied forces running the takedown and narrative transition.

questions.question: What is the E.B.S. in this sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: A Phase Three tunnel-mapping tool used only to chart underground shipping routes with no public media role.
options.rationale: Phase Three dismantled underground infrastructure; E.B.S. is the media takeover system for public truth delivery.

options.label: B
options.text: A sleeper-only social app that restores trust in world police without any military or Whitehat involvement.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is the Emergency Broadcast System taking over media networks under the larger Whitehat-managed purge sequence.

options.label: C
options.text: A permanent Narrative Maintenance studio that only airs fake meetings and ceremonies with no truth disclosure ever planned.
options.rationale: Narrative Maintenance is Phase Four optics; E.B.S. is the later system that delivers ultimate truth after the lockdown window.

options.label: D
options.text: The Emergency Broadcast System that takes over media networks to deliver the ultimate truth to the public.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is the Emergency Broadcast System that takes over media networks to deliver the ultimate truth to the public.

questions.hint: The system that seizes media to deliver ultimate truth.

questions.question: What is true of visible global leadership and routine governance during these bridge phases?

options.label: A
options.text: Only Phase Eight tribunals are running live while Phase Four stand-ins and Phase Five triggers are skipped entirely, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Four through Six are the theatrical bridge before Seven and Eight; fabricated leadership theater is still active in this window.

options.label: B
options.text: Every world leader, corporate head, and cultural influencer still holds full original free-will power with no stand-in optics layer.
options.rationale: Those figures were covertly removed in earlier phases; what remains visible is stand-in theater, not original free-will power.

options.label: C
options.text: Events perceived as current global leadership and routine governance are entirely fabricated theater running on Narrative Maintenance.
options.rationale: After covert removal of leaders and influencers, the visible world operates strictly on Narrative Maintenance as fabricated theater.

options.label: D
options.text: Leadership optics are abandoned on day one so streets fill with unmanaged chaos before any lockdown window is prepared, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Narrative Maintenance deliberately upholds business-as-usual optics so sleepers stay manageable until the mass reveal window.

questions.hint: What the public sees after covert removal of real power.

questions.question: How should staged geopolitical tensions, air raid sirens, and supply chain disruptions be understood?

options.label: A
options.text: Proof that Whitehats lost control and that parasitic underground economies have fully returned to fund real open war.
options.rationale: The distress is orchestrated theatrical pressure after those economies were neutralized, not proof of a returned underground war machine.

options.label: B
options.text: Not organic chaos but a meticulously orchestrated operation to stretch mass public consciousness to the edge of awareness.
options.rationale: Global distress of that kind is orchestrated to stretch mass public consciousness to the edge of awareness, not random organic chaos.

options.label: C
options.text: Immediate unfiltered E.B.S. truth packages already disclosing election fraud, trafficking rings, and satanic cults on every channel.
options.rationale: Those disclosures are Phase Seven E.B.S. work; Phase Five stages edge-of-awareness pressure without yet delivering the full truth package.

options.label: D
options.text: Only natural weather cycles with no staged geopolitical, siren, or supply component aimed at public consciousness at all.
options.rationale: The mechanics name staged geopolitical tensions, air raid sirens, and supply disruptions as deliberate operations on mass consciousness.

questions.hint: Not organic chaos — engineered pressure on mass consciousness.

questions.question: What is Phase Four: Narrative Maintenance primarily targeting?

options.label: A
options.text: Open street military lockdowns and staged internet blackouts before any stand-in speeches or fake ceremonies begin.
options.rationale: Military street presence and internet restrictions are Phase Six; Phase Four first holds business-as-usual optics with stand-ins.

options.label: B
options.text: The immediate physical dismantling of underground tunnels, child trafficking pipelines, and the entire hidden economy on camera.
options.rationale: That underground dismantling is Phase Three; Phase Four is narrative optics for sleepers after real power centers fell.

options.label: C
options.text: The perception of the unawakened, keeping business as usual through controlled stand-ins while real power is already gone.
options.rationale: Phase Four targets the perception of the unawakened and uses controlled stand-ins so business carries on as usual.

options.label: D
options.text: Full E.B.S. disclosure of satanic cults and election fraud with no holding pattern for sleeper perception management.
options.rationale: E.B.S. shatter is Phase Seven; Phase Four holds sleepers in a manageable, docile state until the mass reveal window opens.

questions.hint: Perception management for the still-unawakened.

questions.question: How do replaced leaders uphold the illusion during Phase Four?

options.label: A
options.text: They immediately confess every crime on E.B.S. loops so sleepers never experience a business-as-usual optics period.
options.rationale: Stand-ins maintain normal-looking governance; full truth broadcast comes later through E.B.S., not during Phase Four optics.

options.label: B
options.text: They restore full trafficking and adrenochrome pipelines so the stock market can rebuild on the same illicit foundation.
options.rationale: Underground illicit economies were already dismantled; Phase Four maintains visual normalcy, not a return of that lifeblood.

options.label: C
options.text: They only appear inside dismantled DUMBS tunnels and never on surface media that unawakened sleepers actually watch.
options.rationale: Stand-ins replace leaders for public optics — meetings, speeches, and ceremonies the surface population still sees.

options.label: D
options.text: They conduct fake meetings, deliver speeches, and attend public ceremonies so leadership still appears active and legitimate.
options.rationale: Replaced leaders conduct fake meetings, deliver speeches, and attend public ceremonies to uphold the business-as-usual illusion.

questions.hint: Scripted public performance that looks like normal governance.

questions.question: What is the strict purpose of Phase Four Narrative Maintenance?

options.label: A
options.text: To reinstall royalty, prime ministers, and banking heads with original free-will command over the pyramid apex.
options.rationale: Those apex figures were neutralized in Phase One; Phase Four uses stand-ins for optics, not restoration of original parasite command.

options.label: B
options.text: To cancel Phases Five through Eight so trigger events, lockdown, and E.B.S. never pressure public consciousness.
options.rationale: Phase Four is the holding pattern before Phase Five triggers, Phase Six lockdown, and later E.B.S. truth phases.

options.label: C
options.text: To force immediate worldwide panic by revealing every satanic operator before any lockdown containment exists.
options.rationale: Phase Four prevents premature collapse by keeping sleepers docile; panic mitigation is the strategic point of this bridge.

options.label: D
options.text: To hold sleepers in a manageable, docile state until the precise mass reveal window opens.
options.rationale: The strict purpose of Phase Four is to hold sleepers in a manageable, docile state until the precise mass reveal window opens.

questions.hint: Hold sleepers steady until the reveal window opens.

questions.question: Where does Phase Five: Trigger Events shift the operational focus?

options.label: A
options.text: Back onto silent Phase One arrests of Vatican hierarchy with no public-facing geopolitical or supply pressure at all.
options.rationale: Phase One apex arrests already happened; Phase Five is the public-consciousness pressure stage with staged global distress.

options.label: B
options.text: Onto permanent celebration of Real Craft Arrival with no fear theatre, sirens, or supply disruption staging beforehand.
options.rationale: Staged WW3 and fake alien invasion theatre push sleepers into fear before Real Craft Arrival; Phase Five is the tension bridge.

options.label: C
options.text: Onto mass public consciousness, staging tensions and disruptions that push sleepers toward the edge of questioning reality.
options.rationale: Phase Five shifts focus to mass public consciousness, staging operations that push sleepers to the edge of questioning reality.

options.label: D
options.text: Onto Phase Eight truth tribunals and executions as the first public step with no prior questioning pressure built up.
options.rationale: Tribunals are aftermath stabilization; Phase Five first stretches consciousness through staged trigger pressure.

questions.hint: From quiet optics to mass public consciousness pressure.

questions.question: What precise balance do Phase Five trigger mechanics aim for?

options.label: A
options.text: Push sleepers to the absolute edge of questioning their reality without inducing full panic.
options.rationale: Phase Five aims to push sleepers to the absolute edge of questioning reality without inducing full panic.

options.label: B
options.text: Deliver complete E.B.S. packages on election fraud and satanic cults as the very first public pressure step.
options.rationale: Full E.B.S. disclosure is Phase Seven; Phase Five stages geopolitical, siren, and supply pressure without the full truth dump yet.

options.label: C
options.text: Induce total societal collapse and uncontrollable worldwide panic before any military lockdown can contain the environment.
options.rationale: The strategy mitigates uncontrollable panic; Phase Five stops short of full panic while stretching consciousness to the edge.

options.label: D
options.text: Restore total trust in traditional media and world police so questioning never begins among the unawakened masses.
options.rationale: Trigger Events push toward questioning; Phase Six later signals removal of world police and traditional media structures.

questions.hint: Questioning without total panic.

questions.question: What happens when the operation enters Phase Six: The Lockdown Window?

options.label: A
options.text: Only more fake board meetings and award ceremonies with no military street presence or communications control at all, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Fake meetings and ceremonies are Phase Four optics; Phase Six deploys military forces and restricts information channels.

options.label: B
options.text: Visible military forces deploy in the streets to maintain order, signaling removal of world police and traditional media structures.
options.rationale: Phase Six moves into physical and informational control with visible military street presence and removal of world police and traditional media structures.

options.label: C
options.text: Phase One royalty arrests begin for the first time with no prior covert neutralization or stand-in optics layer, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Apex neutralization was Phase One; Phase Six is the later lockdown bridge after Narrative Maintenance and Trigger Events.

options.label: D
options.text: Underground economies reopen under Whitehat logos while sleepers are told nothing has changed in surface governance, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Underground economies were dismantled earlier; Phase Six locks down the physical environment for the coming truth broadcast.

questions.hint: From psychological tension into physical and informational control.

questions.question: Which information-control steps does Phase Six introduce before E.B.S. takeover?

options.label: A
options.text: Only underground tunnel tours for tourists with no public internet or mainstream media dimension to the lockdown, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: Phase Six is surface military and informational control for the truth broadcast, not underground tourism.

options.label: B
options.text: Immediate Phase Eight executions on every corner with no staged communications restriction or media corruption reveal first, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Executions and tribunals are Phase Eight aftermath; Phase Six first builds the controlled informational environment for E.B.S.

options.label: C
options.text: Unlimited internet freedom and stronger mainstream media narrative control with no self-exposure of corruption at all, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The phase restricts internet access in stages and has mainstream media expose its own corruption rather than tightening old narrative control.

options.label: D
options.text: Internet restrictions introduced in stages, and mainstream media exposes its own corruption, preparing the controlled environment for E.B.S.
options.rationale: Phase Six stages internet restrictions and has mainstream media expose its own corruption so E.B.S. can take over cleanly.

questions.hint: Staged net limits and media self-exposure.

options.label: A

options.rationale: Corporate CEOs and cultural influencers are Phase Two; Phase One targets the apex including banking heads and Vatican hierarchy.

options.label: B
options.text: Royals, prime ministers, banking heads, and Vatican hierarchy at the apex of the parasitic pyramid.
options.rationale: Phase One targeted royals, prime ministers, banking heads, and Vatican hierarchy at the apex of the parasitic pyramid.

options.rationale: Underground tunnels and trafficking are Phase Three; Phase One dismantles the apex leadership layers first.

options.label: D
options.text: Only local sports coaches and weather presenters with no reach into royalty, banking, or Vatican hierarchy.
options.rationale: Phase One hits the pyramid apex — royals, prime ministers, banking heads, and Vatican hierarchy — not minor local figures alone.

questions.hint: Highest political, financial, and religious control layers.

questions.question: What did Phase Two enact as the infrastructure sweep?

options.label: A
options.text: Only military street lockdowns and staged internet blackouts with no action against corporate or cultural power.
options.rationale: Military street presence and internet restrictions are Phase Six; Phase Two is the CEO and cultural influencer sweep.

options.label: B
options.text: Only E.B.S. truth packages on election fraud with no corporate or cultural influence infrastructure action.

options.label: D

options.rationale: Vatican hierarchy is named in Phase One apex work; Phase Two specifically sweeps corporate CEOs and cultural influencers.

questions.hint: Corporate and cultural influence layers.

questions.question: What did Phase Three: 3rd Realm Collapse systematically dismantle?

options.label: A
options.text: Only surface fashion brands and award shows with no action on tunnels, trafficking, or hidden finance.
options.rationale: Surface cultural influence is Phase Two territory; Phase Three hits subterranean tunnels, trafficking, and the hidden economy.

options.label: B
options.text: Only Narrative Maintenance studios so stand-ins could never hold fake meetings or public ceremonies again.
options.rationale: Narrative Maintenance is Phase Four after the underground collapse; Phase Three targets tunnels, trafficking, and hidden economy.

options.label: C
options.text: Underground tunnels, child trafficking pipelines, and the hidden economy that funded parasitic power.
options.rationale: Phase Three systematically dismantled underground tunnels, child trafficking pipelines, and the hidden economy.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Resonating Sols frequency anchors so NPC programming would never glitch during later false-flag theatre.
options.rationale: Resonating Sols cut through noise as frequency fractures; Phase Three dismantles underground parasitic infrastructure, not light anchors.

questions.hint: Subterranean crime and hidden economic lifeblood.

questions.question: Why are Phases Four through Six described as entirely theatrical?

options.label: A
options.text: Because Whitehats abandoned the realm and left sleepers with no military, multi-dimensional, or narrative management at all.
options.rationale: Whitehats orchestrate the takedown and narrative transition; the theatrical bridge is managed, not an abandonment.

options.label: B
options.text: Because true power centers were neutralized covertly, these phases function as a psychological bridge to prevent total societal collapse.
options.rationale: With true power already removed covertly, Phases Four through Six are theatrical psychological bridging to prevent total societal collapse.

options.label: C
options.text: Because Phase Seven E.B.S. and Phase Eight tribunals were cancelled, leaving permanent stand-in governance forever, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: These phases prepare the terrain for Phase Seven E.B.S. and Phase Eight stabilization rather than cancelling those later steps.

options.label: D
options.text: Because no prior neutralization happened and every royal, CEO, and trafficking pipeline still holds full original power, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Prior phases already dismantled apex, influencers, and underground economies; the theatre exists because real power is already gone.

questions.hint: True power centers were already neutralized covertly.

questions.question: What does Phase Seven disclose, and what does Phase Eight secure afterward?

options.label: A
options.text: Phase Seven only airs more fake stand-in ceremonies; Phase Eight reopens underground tunnels and child trafficking for a new hidden economy.
options.rationale: Phase Seven discloses the crimes; Phase Eight stabilizes through tribunals and executions rather than rebuilding underground crime.

options.label: B
options.text: Phase Seven and Eight only repeat Phase Four Narrative Maintenance with no E.B.S. disclosure or tribunal function at all, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Four is the holding pattern; Seven and Eight are overt revelation and stabilization after the lockdown window prepares the field.

options.label: C
options.text: Phase Seven restores Vatican and banking free-will power; Phase Eight cancels all military lockdowns with no justice process, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Seven and Eight reveal crimes and execute justice after the bridge phases, not restore apex parasites or cancel justice.

options.label: D
options.text: Phase Seven E.B.S. discloses election fraud, trafficking rings, and satanic cults; Phase Eight secures the realm through truth tribunals and executions.
options.rationale: Phase Seven shatters false reality by disclosing election fraud, trafficking rings, and satanic cults; Phase Eight uses truth tribunals and executions for aftermath stabilization.

questions.hint: E.B.S. shatter contents, then tribunals and executions.

questions.question: What strategic effect do Phases Four through Six create for NPC programming and Resonating Sols?

options.label: A
options.text: They cancel all trigger pressure and lockdown so sleepers remain in oblivious slumber without any path toward mass reveal, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Four through Six deliberately move sleepers from slumber through questioning into lockdown prepared for the truth broadcast.

options.label: B
options.text: They only rebuild A.I. War Theatre forever with no path to Real Craft Arrival or any break of the frequency net, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Staged WW3 and fake alien invasion theatre push sleepers into fear before Real Craft Arrival breaks the frequency net.

options.label: C
options.text: They force NPC Programming to glitch and flicker as false-flag narratives wobble, creating frequency fracture so Resonating Sols signals cut through and anchor the truth.
options.rationale: Timed psychological pressure breaks NPC Programming into glitches, creates frequency fracture, and lets Resonating Sols signals cut through to anchor truth.

options.label: D
options.text: They permanently strengthen NPC Programming and seal the frequency net so Resonating Sols can never cut through staged fear theatre, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The sequence breaks NPC Programming down and opens frequency fracture for Resonating Sols, rather than sealing them out forever.

questions.hint: Glitching false flags, frequency fracture, truth anchors.
